# ImageToEventConversion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A real-time method that transforms conventional image frames into event-based spike streams for direct input to spiking neural networks. Enables seamless integration of standard vision sensors with neuromorphic SNN pipelines, critical for practical iNEST deployment without specialized event cameras.
